summary: New product skill diorama-effects (experimental): how a consumer app applies the effects layer (ADR 0022) — the class-on-the-root pattern, the setup order (@layer fx after Tailwind and the theme; startShaders() once at the root), which effect answers which job, what the layer already guarantees so an app does not re-solve it (per-brand glass tint, per-pixel contrast guard, reduced motion and transparency, forced colours), the tuning tokens, and the traps already paid for: refraction outside the web stack, halo clipping, sheen on a pale accent, iOS canvas clipping, a stale shader copy covering a Slider thumb.
